violation_type.title: Field Trips-Food Allergy Emergency Plan and Allergy Medications (26 TAC §744.2301(5))
violation_type.short_title: Field Trips-Food Allergy Emergency Plan and Allergy Medications
violation_type.typical_finding: One child attending field trip with a diagnosed food allergy on enrollment form did not have a food allergy emergency plan.     One child with a diagnosed food allergy did not have medication required on food allergy emergency plan.

finding_variants.text: One child attending field trip with a diagnosed food allergy on enrollment form did not have a food allergy emergency plan.     One child with a diagnosed food allergy did not have medication required on food allergy emergency plan.

Two children with a diagnosed food allergy did not have food allergy emergency plan.     This was corrected at inspection when the food allergy plan was received for one child, and the admission form for the second child was updated to remove that the child has a food allergy after receiving email verification from the parent.
1  out of 8 children's files reviewed did not have a completed food allergy emergency plan available for review.
